Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.dataWeReadBody: With your permission, we read your register's sales, order, catalog, staff and timecard data (read-only — we can never change anything or move your money). We also store the costs, bills, receipts and bank lines you give us.
Privacy.dataWeNeverTouchBody: We never ask for your bank or register password. We never see your customers' card numbers. We never move money or place orders on your behalf.
Privacy.howWeProtectItBody: Register connection tokens are encrypted at rest. Uploaded files are private to your business. We never log tokens, bank lines, or receipt images.
Privacy.aiUseBody: We use AI to read receipts, categorize bank statement lines, and parse voice entries you record. Only the data needed for that task is sent, never your customers' names or card numbers.
Privacy.yourControlBody: You can review, correct, or remove any cost we've recorded. You can disconnect your register at any time from Settings.
Privacy.deletingYourAccountBody: Deleting your account permanently removes your business data and files, and disconnects any connected register. This can't be undone.
